answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the pearl check immediately, the jetty audit keeps the resolved set and the zephyr replay reveals exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 45 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 45 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
